steps.code:
# Let's parse the file content to extract song titles and artists
import re

content = file_content['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
archive_songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist"
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " (last occurrence)
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artist = line.rsplit(' by ', 1)
        archive_songs.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))
    else:
        # Maybe just title?
        archive_songs.append((line.strip(), None))

print(archive_songs)
